role: Lexical-chain word sense disambiguation for polysemous words via conversation context
detail: Resolves polysemy (e.g., "bank" financial vs. river) by scoring candidate WordSenseNode entries against recent conversation history. Two main classes: DisambiguationResult (frozen dataclass with selected_sense_id, confidence, strategy, candidate_senses list) and DisambiguationEngine (async engine that walks PRECEDES chain backward from current turn, accumulates salience from MENTIONS edges, applies recency decay, checks threshold, returns escalation if unresolvable). Algorithm: find all WordSenseNodes matching spelling → if zero escalate, if one return with 1.0 confidence, if multiple walk PRECEDES chain up to 10 hops, score each sense via salience*decay**hop, check if top score >= 0.7 for lexical_chain strategy else escalate. Includes SAME_SPELLING indirect scoring at 0.5 multiplier for linked senses. Constants: _MAX_CHAIN_HOPS=10, _SELECTION_THRESHOLD=0.7, _DECAY=0.9. Logs all outcomes (no_senses, single_sense, lexical_chain, escalate) via logger.
gotchas: No error handling for missing edges or null values beyond empty list checks; assumes GraphPersistence queries return complete results; indirect SAME_SPELLING scoring (0.5 multiplier) is hardcoded; Phase 1.7-E4 phase marker suggests this may be in pre-release/experimental state
